name: Whiteboard lesson (Khan-style)
description: Calm, continuous drawing lesson: pauses kept, a typed question up front and a simple end card. A quiet music bed (when you supply music) is added. Zoom-ins and a chalkboard background are listed as not available yet.
author: dax-editor contributors

beats.name: Question
beats.guidance: Ask the question, then start drawing.

beats.name: Sketch and explain
beats.guidance: One continuous drawing; avoid many fonts and long unbroken zooms.

beats.name: Recap
beats.guidance: Say the answer again in one sentence.

beats.name: Next step
beats.guidance: Point to practice or the next lesson.

effects.title: Quiet music bed
effects.description: Very low music under the narration, lowered further while someone speaks.

deferred.title: Zoom-ins and callouts
deferred.description: Zoom into the part of the board being explained. The zoom itself exists (add_zoom with a focus point), but the editor cannot tell which part that is.

deferred.title: Dark chalkboard background
deferred.description: A digital chalkboard behind the drawing.

notes.text: Use only music you have the right to use: a licensed or CC0 library, or your own. Do not reuse a platform's in-app sound library on other platforms, and check that the licence covers paid ads if you promote the video.
Check facts, formulas and units before publishing; teaching videos get reused for a long time.
Footage, images, memes, logos and music from other people need permission or a licence that covers your use. Fair use depends on the country and is not automatic.
The style name describes a publicly discussed editing pattern. This template is not affiliated with or endorsed by any creator, and it does not copy anyone's footage, graphics or captions.
